svg.title: Hyperbolic-Plane Descent Tower and Rank-One Four-Block Height Ledger in Stage 06
svg.desc: Two-panel editorial mathematical diagram of the Stage 06 analytic engines in PeriodsOfFalseLifts.lean and TwistedValueHeights.lean. The left panel depicts the Hyperbolic-Plane Descent Tower (PeriodsOfFalseLifts.lean): a false lift Xi in falseLiftsAt is simultaneously annihilated by (1) hyperplane sums at chosen places (HyperplaneSumsAnnihilate), (2) theta descent to W (normalizedDescent Xi = 0), and (3) the split-place Hecke polynomial H_w(X_*) at liftHeckeRoot w of modulus q^(1 - n + r/2). Gated by the strict inequality 2r + 2N + 3 < n and nontrivial O.tamePart at every twist place, upward induction climbs from W (BottomOfTower) through W + H and intermediate HyperbolicPlaneStep rungs to W + H^N (descentsVanish_hyperbolicSum), where small-root Hecke vanishing kills bounded descents at every rung. Taking Fourier coefficients on any split I_n = I_N + I_l kills complementary block periods (stdClassSum_gramForm_eq_zero), feeding both DividedSplitting.stdClassSum_inner_productForm_eq_zero into GluingMaps.lean and rank-one stdClassSum_period_eq_zero (with 2*1 + 2*20 + 3 = 45 < 2z) across the center channel into TwistedValueHeights.lean. The right panel depicts the Four-Block Seesaw and 4-Factor Height Ledger (TwistedValueHeights.lean): RankOneIndex p.z (2z coordinates) partitions into Fin 12 (modKernel plus Stage 02 BoundAttained capping upward p-adic penalty at + sum primeSum), Fin 4 (ramified flat q_2 twisted by vartheta with integralAlgebraicPart and ratio rho = q_2.ratio vartheta), Fin 4 (untwisted flat q_3 via tameChars pigeonhole), and Fin (2z - 20) (untwisted flat q via trivialLiftClassSum giving IsTestForm orthogonal to false lifts). Projecting conjugate-paired test forms Xi, Xi' onto C*phi_vartheta produces the 4-factor height ledger for (p.ratio (theta iota ^ j))^(-1) in heightLe_inv_ratio: Factor 1 ||phi_1||^2 (AlgebraicPartSize) contributes denominatorBudget - sum jetSize (where the minus sign enters); Factor 2 <pr Xi, pr Xi'> (IsRegularFamily) contributes + denominatorBudget; Factor 3 rho^(-2) (HasSmallRatios) contributes + 2 x_1 <= + 2 denominatorBudget; Factor 4 rho^2 / (<Xi, phi><phi, Xi'>) (BoundAttained conjugate-paired) contributes + 2 denominatorBudget + sum primeSum (an upward p-adic bound strictly smaller than the archimedean credit). Summing yields 6 denominatorBudget - D.directionAmount. At the bottom, exact pair counts in heightLe_inv_heckeValueProd_div combine #A = k/2 main pairs (squared to k) and #B = 5m ramified pairs (squared to 10m) to give Height(Gamma_j(1)/Gamma_j(theta(iota)^j)) <= 10 m x_1 + k (6 denominatorBudget - D.directionAmount).
